global: This shoyu ramen features an amber-brown, glossy, steaming broth with thin noodles and shredded cabbage. In a white ceramic bowl with a glossy rim, tender pale pink chashu pork with green onion sits beside a curved reddish-brown spoon on a vibrant red table.

regions.background: The table is a solid, vibrant red surface with smooth texture and subtle light reflections.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, subtly textured rim.
regions.soup: The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is amber-brown, glossy, and steaming, with thin noodles and shredded cabbage floating on its surface.
regions.spoon: A curved, glossy reddish-brown spoon with smooth surface and slight wear visible.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice shows tender, pale pink meat with slight fat marbling and a small green onion garnish on top.
